title: 58HF+X8, Dubai
description: The Symphony by Imtiaz presents a distinctive vision of contemporary luxury, where sculptural architecture, fluid forms, and refined design come together in a harmonious residential concept. Inspired by the architectural philosophy associated with Zaha Hadid, the development embraces expressive curves, geometric precision, and the interplay of light and shadow to create a striking architectural presence. Every element reflects a considered balance between artistic expression and everyday functionality, offering a sophisticated living environment shaped by design and tranquillity. Residences and interiors The residential collection includes elegant 1-bedroom apartments, spacious duplex residences, and refined master suites. Interiors are designed around natural textures, soft lighting, and seamless transitions between living spaces, creating an atmosphere of openness and calm. Open-plan kitchens connect effortlessly with living and dining areas, while private balconies extend the living experience outdoors, framing views of the surrounding cityscape. Thoughtfully planned layouts maximise space and functionality while maintaining the development's distinctive design language. The result is a contemporary home environment where architectural character meets comfort and understated elegance. Amenities and lifestyle The Symphony offers a curated range of amenities designed to support wellness, relaxation, and social connection. The clubhouse features inviting lounge areas, billiards, and a dedicated reading corner, providing comfortable spaces for leisure and interaction. The fitness studio is equipped for mindful movement and full-body training, while the landscaped podium garden introduces a tranquil green retreat within the development. Rooftop and social spaces provide additional settings for relaxation, gathering, and enjoying the surrounding views. Across these shared spaces, thoughtful design and natural elements contribute to an atmosphere of contemporary sophistication. Finishes and smart-home features The interiors combine modern aesthetics with high-quality materials and carefully selected international brands. Bathrooms feature sanitaryware by Villeroy & Boch, technical solutions from Geberit, and designer fittings by Gessi, adding a refined touch to everyday routines. Kitchens and household areas may include appliances from leading brands such as Bosch and Samsung. Smart-home features integrated with Alexa offer added convenience, supporting a more seamless and connected living experience. Together, these details reinforce the development's emphasis on quality, functionality, and considered design. Location and lifestyle Located in Meydan City, The Symphony benefits from a prestigious Dubai address that combines contemporary residential living with open spaces and access to major city destinations. The area is known for the iconic Meydan Racecourse, home to the renowned Dubai World Cup, which brings international attention and a distinctive sporting atmosphere to the neighbourhood. Meydan City also features landscaped gardens, parks, and tree-lined streets, offering opportunities for outdoor recreation, walking, cycling, and community activities. These green spaces provide a welcome contrast to Dubai's dynamic urban environment. With road connections to key destinations across Dubai, Meydan offers access to business districts, shopping venues, dining destinations, and entertainment options. Its combination of modern infrastructure, recreational surroundings, and a prominent address makes it an appealing location for residents seeking a balance between city convenience and a more tranquil residential setting. The Symphony brings together expressive architecture, premium interior details, and thoughtfully designed lifestyle amenities to create a distinctive residential experience in Meydan City.

description: Maybach Ultimate Luxury is an iconic Mercedes-branded residential development by Binghatti, located in the prestigious Meydan district. The project features two striking towers, each comprising a basement level, ground floor, mezzanine, five podium levels, and an elegant residential structure - with nineteen floors in Tower A and twenty-five in Tower B. Designed to embody sophistication and architectural excellence, the complex stands as a symbol of branded luxury living in Dubai. The development offers a refined selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit both homeowners and investors. Interiors showcase a contemporary aesthetic defined by clean architectural lines, premium materials, rich textures, and a warm, elegant color palette. Every detail is curated to reflect understated luxury and timeless style. Residents are treated to an exceptional array of lifestyle amenities, including a stunning infinity swimming pool, a shared jacuzzi, and dedicated outdoor yoga spaces. The development also features beautifully designed leisure and relaxation areas, premium beauty salons, diverse dining outlets, and well-equipped sports facilities. Complemented by valet parking and professional concierge services, every detail is thoughtfully curated to provide comfort, convenience, and elevated everyday living. The residential component features a refined collection of luxury towers designed to reflect the innovation, performance, and sophistication associated with the Mercedes-Benz brand. Homes are envisioned as contemporary urban sanctuaries, offering elegant layouts, expansive views, and a strong connection to the surrounding cityscape. Premium materials, meticulous detailing, and high-quality finishes define both interiors and common areas, creating a living environment where luxury, precision, and timeless design converge. Location description and benefits Meydan is one of Dubai's most ambitious and prestigious districts, designed as a contemporary urban destination where luxury, nature, and innovation converge. Known for its expansive open spaces and iconic skyline views, the area blends modern residential developments with landscaped parks, waterways, and cultural landmarks. Meydan's master-planned environment offers a sense of scale, openness, and refinement rarely found in central urban locations. The district is internationally recognized for Meydan Racecourse, a world-class equestrian and sporting venue that hosts prestigious global events and anchors the area's elite identity. Surrounding the racecourse are premium residential communities, leisure destinations, retail concepts, and wellness-focused spaces, all thoughtfully integrated to support a high-quality lifestyle. Wide boulevards, pedestrian-friendly planning, and scenic vistas define the everyday experience in Meydan. Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, Meydan offers both lifestyle appeal and strong investment potential. Its limited land availability, ongoing development momentum, and growing demand for branded and luxury residences position Meydan as a prime destination for end-users and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai's most forward-looking districts.

description: Mirari Lagoon by Zoya Developments presents a thoughtfully designed collection of studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, bringing together contemporary architecture, elegant interiors, and resort-inspired living. Located in Dubai Industrial City, the development offers fully furnished residences designed to provide comfort, functionality, and modern convenience. With stylish layouts and carefully planned living spaces, each residence creates a welcoming environment for individuals, couples, and families seeking a contemporary home in Dubai. The development offers a range of lifestyle amenities designed to support relaxation, wellness, and recreation. Residents can enjoy a lagoon-inspired swimming pool, infinity pool, fully equipped fitness centre, jogging track, poolside cabanas, and landscaped outdoor spaces. Dedicated leisure and relaxation areas create opportunities to unwind, enjoy outdoor activities, and experience a resort-style atmosphere within the residential community. Mirari Lagoon combines modern residential comfort with a leisure-focused lifestyle, creating an environment where everyday living is complemented by recreational facilities and thoughtfully designed surroundings. Its fully furnished apartments, contemporary design, and selection of lifestyle amenities make the development an appealing choice for both homeowners and investors looking for a modern residential property in Dubai. With its location in Dubai Industrial City, Mirari Lagoon offers connectivity to key destinations across Dubai. Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai are approximately 10 minutes away, while Palm Jebel Ali is around 20 minutes away. Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai are also accessible by road, offering residents convenient access to shopping, entertainment, business, and leisure destinations. The project features studio apartments starting from approximately AED 565,000, 1-bedroom apartments from AED 899,000, and 2-bedroom apartments from AED 1,127,000. Buyers can benefit from an advertised flexible payment plan of 20% on booking, 28% during construction, 10% on handover, and 42% post-handover over 60 months. With its fully furnished residences, resort-inspired amenities, and flexible payment structure, Mirari Lagoon presents an attractive opportunity for those looking to own a home or explore property investment in Dubai. Location Description & Benefits Dubai Industrial City is an established industrial and commercial destination within the wider Dubai South region, offering connectivity to important transport, logistics, and business hubs. Its strategic position makes it an emerging location for residential developments, particularly for professionals and residents seeking convenient access to employment and infrastructure. The surrounding area benefits from its proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, and major road networks connecting different parts of the emirate. These destinations contribute to the area's long-term development potential and accessibility. Residents can also reach shopping, dining, entertainment, and everyday facilities across nearby communities. With its growing infrastructure, strategic connectivity, and proximity to major development zones in southern Dubai, Dubai Industrial City offers an interesting residential and investment location. Mirari Lagoon brings together modern furnished apartments, leisure facilities, and convenient access to key destinations, creating a contemporary living option within this developing part of Dubai.

City of Arabia is associated with major planned attractions, including Mall of Arabia and the Restless Planet theme park concept. As development progresses, the wider district aims to offer a blend of shopping, dining, family entertainment, and recreational spaces within a connected community environment. Dubailand provides access to several established residential neighbourhoods and leisure destinations across Dubai. Road connections link the area with other parts of the city, making it a location to consider for residents seeking a contemporary home away from the busiest central districts. Combining Italian-inspired design, a broad range of amenities, and a lagoon-centred lifestyle, Azizi Milan offers a distinctive residential concept for buyers looking for modern living and potential investment opportunities in Dubailand.

description: The Archive by Imtiaz reimagines contemporary residential living through a distinctive concept inspired by literature, creativity, and intellectual wellbeing. At the heart of this unique development is a curated collection of approximately 10,000 real books, creating an environment where architecture and the art of reading come together. From an impressive two-storey library featuring an elegant spiral staircase to a dedicated writer's room designed to inspire creativity, every space reflects a thoughtful approach to modern living. Amenities and lifestyle The Archive offers a carefully curated selection of amenities designed to support physical wellness, relaxation, and creative inspiration. Fitness enthusiasts can enjoy a state-of-the-art gym shaped around Imtiaz's Raw Theory wellness philosophy, while the rooftop swimming pool provides a peaceful setting to unwind. Additional amenities include a BBQ lounge, outdoor cinema, landscaped garden with floating cabanas, and a mini golf course, offering opportunities for recreation and social gatherings. Dedicated reading lounges and thoughtfully designed communal spaces further distinguish the development, creating an atmosphere that encourages quiet reflection, meaningful conversations, and a deeper appreciation of everyday life. Interiors and finishes The interiors embrace a refined, literary-inspired aesthetic, balancing contemporary design with spaces dedicated to reading, creativity, and relaxation. Reading lounges provide inviting corners for quiet moments, while the rooftop salon, featuring a fireplace and comfortable deep seating, offers an elegant setting for socialising or unwinding. Modern finishes and high-quality materials complement the architectural concept, creating interiors that combine comfort, functionality, and understated sophistication. The overall design offers a distinctive residential experience for those who appreciate thoughtful spaces and a lifestyle centred on culture and wellbeing. Location and lifestyle Situated in Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), The Archive benefits from a residential setting with access to major road networks, including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. This connectivity provides convenient routes to key destinations across Dubai, supporting both professional and personal lifestyles. The surrounding area offers access to shopping, entertainment, education, and leisure destinations. Popular attractions such as Dubai Outlet Mall, IMG Worlds of Adventure, and Global Village are accessible by road, while cultural and lifestyle destinations including Mohammed Bin Rashid Library, Dubai Design District, Dubai Creek Harbour, and Downtown Dubai provide further options for exploration. DLRC offers a residential atmosphere away from some of Dubai's busiest central districts while maintaining road access to business hubs, retail destinations, and other key areas of the city. Its combination of everyday convenience and connectivity makes it an option for professionals, families, and investors seeking a home within Dubai's expanding residential landscape. The Archive stands apart through its distinctive literary concept, thoughtfully designed amenities, and contemporary residences, offering a lifestyle where modern comfort meets creativity, culture, and wellbeing.

title: Dubai Islands, Dubai
description: Isla Private Residences is a boutique waterfront development on Dubai Islands by Chaimaa Holding, conceived around the philosophy of Dolce Far Niente - the art of refined, intentional living. The project comprises an exclusive collection of 76 one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences, defined by sculptural architecture, flowing terraces, and expansive glazing that frames open sea and skyline views. The building's elegant curves, landscaped podium, and expressive rooftop silhouette create a distinctive presence within the coastal destination of Dubai Islands. The development offers 32 amenities curated across three dedicated lifestyle levels, thoughtfully divided into family, wellness, social, and entertainment experiences. Highlights include a Sanctuary Pool and dedicated children's splash areas, a salt sauna and cold plunge pool for contrast therapy, and a rooftop infinity pool overlooking the sea. Social spaces extend beyond traditional lounges, featuring asunken seating with a fireplace, communal dining terraces, and an outdoor cinema. A rooftop sports lounge and bar, secret garden zones, yoga terraces, and a dedicated entertainment lounge for teens and young adults add a distinctive layer of community-focused living rarely seen in boutique projects on Dubai Islands. Interiors are designed with an emphasis on light, proportion, and refined materiality. Floor-to-ceiling windows enhance openness and natural illumination, while contemporary kitchens integrate premium appliances and generous worktops to balance aesthetics with practicality. Bathrooms are conceived as spa-inspired environments, featuring upscale fittings and sophisticated materials that elevate everyday rituals. Each residence includes dedicated utility areas and private balconies, reinforcing seamless indoor-outdoor living and a sense of tranquil coastal retreat. Location description and benefits Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters. The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities. Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

They offer smart home technology, private pools in selected units, and a flexible payment plan of 50% during construction and 50% on completion. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: 78Q2+2Q, Dubai
description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

description: Project general facts This is a boutique residential building, with a ground floor and four residential floors. Inspired by the idea of composition, the architecture combines warm bronze tones, rounded corners and wide glazed balconies with slim railings, giving the facade a soft, horizontal rhythm. Slatted canopies crown the rooftop, and palm trees and planters soften the edges of the building and its terraces. The compact scale of the project creates a quiet, private atmosphere for residents. Amenities are designed for wellness, leisure and family life. The rooftop features an open swimming pool with sun loungers under a curved slatted canopy, alongside a rooftop lounge with sofas and low tables among landscaped planters. Residents also have a gym with views over the district, an outdoor yoga deck and a barbecue area for gatherings in the open air. Families benefit from a kids' pool and a dedicated kids' play area, while an elegant entrance lobby welcomes residents and guests. The building offers studios and two-bedroom apartments, which suits both single residents and small families. All residences are delivered fully furnished, with refined interiors in soft neutral tones, natural materials and warm lighting. Kitchens and living areas are arranged around natural light, and private balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, while the low-rise, boutique format keeps the building calm and private. Location description and benefits Dubai South Residential District is a master-planned residential area in the south of Dubai, developed around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The district combines low-rise residential buildings, green streets, parks and community facilities in a calm suburban setting, and it continues to grow as new homes, schools and retail are added around the airport and the Expo City business area. Road links connect the area with Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, giving access to Jebel Ali, Dubai Investments Park and the rest of the city. Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Parks and Resorts are among the major destinations within easy reach, and the wider Dubai South area also includes logistics and business zones that bring jobs close to home for many residents. The district appeals to buyers looking for an accessible entry point into a growing part of Dubai. Compact studios and two-bedroom apartments here suit young professionals, couples and small families who want a quiet residential setting, as well as investors interested in rental demand linked to the airport, the logistics hub and the continued development of Expo City Dubai. description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. Additionally, the discovery of an Eastern Christian monastery from the same period provides insight into the region's diverse cultural heritage. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. Recognizing its potential, the Umm Al Quwain government has initiated a development project to introduce leisure, hotel, and residential properties to Siniyah Island, aiming to blend its rich history with modern amenities. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious seaside lifestyle, set amidst lush landscapes and serene surroundings. It seamlessly integrates natural beauty and refined architectural design, boasting pristine beaches with velvety white sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Residents enjoy direct beach and lagoon access, expansive views of the Arabian Gulf, and lush green vistas overlooking a meticulously designed 18-hole golf course. The development features premium amenities including an infinity swimming pool, an outdoor cinema, a state-of-the-art fitness centre, and multiple children's play areas. For leisure and relaxation, landscaped parks, tranquil gardens, and a vibrant community centre provide perfect spaces to unwind. Additionally, thrill-seekers can indulge in exhilarating water sports such as scuba diving, snorkeling, kite surfing, and paddleboarding. The retail boulevard offers a sensory feast with charming cafes and gourmet dining, enhancing the vibrant community atmosphere. Exclusive services such as a yacht club, a shopping mall, luxury resorts, and a helipad further elevate the sophisticated lifestyle experience provided by this prestigious island residence. The project offers elegantly designed interiors across a selection of premium 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and duplexes, carefully crafted to blend modern comfort with sophisticated aesthetics. title: Old Town, Umm al-Quwain
description: Modern Waterfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a natural sanctuary renowned for its unspoiled white sand beaches, clear blue waters, and rich biodiversity, including mangroves that provide habitat for species such as flamingos, turtles, oryxes, and gazelles. The island holds historical significance as the oldest pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf and is home to an ancient Eastern Christian monastery, reflecting its vibrant past. Recent developments aim to transform Siniyah Island into a premier destination, blending luxury living with ecological preservation while maintaining its cultural heritage. Apartments for sale on Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, are conveniently located just 5 minutes from essential services, 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project is situated in a stunning island setting, blending refined waterfront elegance and lush natural beauty. Its exterior showcases contemporary architectural brilliance seamlessly integrated with serene sea views, sun-drenched promenades, and a dynamic marina. The residences boast direct access to a motorized seawater body, a yacht club with mooring facilities, and a lively promenade enriched by fine dining, boutique cafés, and vibrant nightlife. Residents enjoy podium-level infinity pools, cutting-edge fitness centers with marina views, cozy lounges, and engaging outdoor play zones. Expansive landscaped gardens and parks add to the tranquil setting, while a luxury hotel and a high-end mall offer indulgence and convenience. Additional features include a fully operational golf course, helipad, exclusive resorts, and seamless pedestrian connectivity via a scenic bridge, all thoughtfully designed to elevate coastal living into a lifestyle of refined leisure and adventure. The project presents a refined selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, where modern design meets exceptional functionality across three residential towers. Tower C offers fully furnished units, offering a sophisticated turnkey solution with elegant furniture, fitted wardrobes, and kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods for a seamless move-in experience. Towers A and B are semi-furnished, featuring the same premium built-in wardrobes and fully fitted kitchens, allowing residents to personalize their living spaces while enjoying core conveniences. Interiors are spacious and light-filled, enhanced by thoughtfully curated layouts, en-suite bathrooms, powder rooms, and private balconies that frame serene views of the marina, park, or sea. Every detail has been crafted to reflect contemporary coastal elegance, offering residents a perfect balance between luxurious comfort and everyday practicality. UAQ-00010

Among them are themed gardens, green trails, meditation areas, reading spaces, coworking areas and social squares. The complex also includes indoor and outdoor gyms, spa, massage rooms, sauna, swimming pools with rest areas, cabanas and submerged areas. For physical activities, paddle, squash and volleyball courts, climbing wall, multipurpose courts, golf simulators, training circuits and walking and running courses are available. Families have multiple spaces dedicated to children and young people, such as parks, interactive areas, game rooms, skate park and technology areas. Pets also have parks, washing areas, pet salon and dedicated services at their disposal. It is an environment designed for those looking for a life of high comfort and exclusivity, in a place where every detail has been carefully designed to provide a superior residential experience. description: Mar Casa is a striking residential landmark inspired by the natural fluidity and movement of ocean waves. Its distinctive architecture creates a sculptural presence, while the residences are thoughtfully designed to maximise panoramic ocean views through airy layouts, expansive glazing, and well-balanced living spaces. More than a residence, Mar Casa presents an elevated interpretation of waterfront living, combining architectural character with a sense of calm and refined luxury. The development integrates modern technology and intelligent living features designed to enhance everyday convenience and security. Residences are equipped with an Advanced IP Intercom system for seamless communication, Smart Access Control for secure entry to common areas, and Smart Home technology that allows residents to conveniently manage key aspects of their living environment. Every home is finished with carefully selected materials that reflect a contemporary sense of quality. Wardrobes and doors feature high-grade laminate finishes, complemented by branded sanitaryware and accessories. Depending on the residence, flooring is finished in stone or porcelain tiles, while painted walls and ceilings create a clean and sophisticated backdrop. Kitchens are equipped with high-end branded appliances, bringing together functionality and refined design. With its ocean-inspired architecture, panoramic outlooks, premium interiors, and intelligent home features, Mar Casa offers a sophisticated residential experience for those seeking a distinctive waterfront lifestyle. The combination of thoughtful design, modern convenience, and a prestigious setting creates homes that are both elegant and highly functional. Location Description & Benefits Dubai Maritime City is a distinctive waterfront peninsula designed as an integrated destination where residential, commercial, hospitality, and leisure experiences come together. description: Seafront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island Siniya Island, located in Umm Al Quwain, is an emerging residential and leisure destination renowned for its tranquil natural beauty and serene island atmosphere. Surrounded by crystal-clear waters and pristine beaches, it provides a unique blend of relaxation and adventure, featuring exclusive residential communities, luxurious amenities, and diverse recreational options such as golfing, water sports, and eco-tourism activities. Its strategic position, away from the city's bustle yet conveniently accessible, makes it an ideal retreat for residents seeking tranquility combined with modern comfort. The project offers a luxurious coastal living experience, prominently featuring pristine natural beaches, serene lagoon beaches, and vibrant landscaped parks. Additional sophisticated conveniences include an exclusive yacht club, a vibrant retail boulevard with open-air cafés and gourmet dining options, an upscale shopping mall, and luxurious resorts. All units come equipped with fitted wardrobes, providing both functionality and aesthetic appeal, and modern kitchens fitted with high-quality white goods, enhancing convenience and elegance. Expansive windows and private balconies optimize natural lighting and allow residents to enjoy serene views of the surrounding natural landscapes, pristine beaches, and tranquil lagoons. description: Azizi Wasel is a contemporary waterfront residential development on Dubai Islands, offering an exceptional collection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, alongside exclusive four-bedroom penthouses. Defined by sleek architectural lines, expansive glass façades, and thoughtfully designed open spaces, the development embraces natural light and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai skyline further enhance its appeal, creating a sophisticated residential environment where modern design meets coastal tranquillity. The development offers a carefully selected range of amenities designed to complement a relaxed yet active lifestyle. Residents can enjoy swimming pools, a fully equipped modern gym, landscaped gardens, and a multipurpose hall for community gatherings and social events. On-site retail outlets provide convenient access to everyday essentials, while dedicated children's play areas create a welcoming environment for families. Every feature is designed to balance leisure, convenience, and community living within an attractive waterfront setting. Location Description and Benefits Dubai Islands is an ambitious coastal destination designed to bring together waterfront residences, leisure attractions, hospitality, and contemporary urban living. Comprising five interconnected islands, the master development features a distinctive blend of residential neighbourhoods, pristine beaches, landscaped spaces, and recreational destinations. Its coastal setting offers residents the opportunity to embrace a more relaxed lifestyle, complemented by scenic sea views and an atmosphere of seaside exclusivity. Connected to mainland Dubai through established road infrastructure, Dubai Islands combines the tranquillity of island living with access to the city's established commercial and lifestyle destinations. Residents can enjoy convenient connectivity to areas such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah, while the surrounding district continues to develop as a destination for waterfront leisure and hospitality. Planned attractions include upscale hotels, fine-dining restaurants, retail destinations, beach clubs, and recreational facilities, creating a vibrant environment for residents and visitors alike. Designed to offer a diverse lifestyle experience, Dubai Islands brings together peaceful residential settings and lively leisure destinations within one coastal masterplan. Its emphasis on landscaped environments, modern infrastructure, and integrated amenities contributes to its long-term appeal as a distinctive waterfront address. Combining coastal scenery, urban accessibility, and a growing selection of lifestyle attractions, Dubai Islands presents an appealing choice for those seeking a contemporary seaside lifestyle in Dubai.

description: Project general facts Sanctuary is a refined residential development set within the prestigious Meydan district, uniquely positioned beside the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. The project's architecture reflects modern sophistication, with a sculpted façade of glass and clean geometry designed to maximize natural light and panoramic views. Sanctuary offers a rare balance between urban elegance and nature, providing residents with uninterrupted vistas of the Dubai skyline and protected natural landscapes, while remaining minutes from Downtown Dubai and major city arteries. The project features an extensive collection of resort-style amenities thoughtfully distributed across dedicated lifestyle levels. Residents enjoy landscaped serenity gardens, waterfall features, sunken island pools, infinity pools, outdoor fitness areas, kids' pools and play zones, BBQ areas, outdoor cinema, jacuzzi, spa-style relaxation pools, and sky gardens with observation decks. Indoor amenities include a state-of-the-art gym, sauna, indoor cinema, games area, and family-friendly communal spaces, creating a holistic living environment focused on wellness, leisure, and community. Interiors at Sanctuary are designed to reflect calm, comfort, and contemporary luxury. Living spaces are bright and spacious, enhanced by large windows that frame natural and skyline views. The residences are delivered without furniture, and interior specifications follow a standard of high-quality finishes with modern materials, aligned with the project's premium positioning. The overall interior concept emphasizes timeless design, functional layouts, and a serene atmosphere that complements the project's nature-inspired setting. Location description and benefits Ras Al Khor is one of Dubai's hidden gems, where urban convenience meets the untouched beauty of nature. Located just minutes from the city's bustling center, this district is best known for the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, a protected reserve that is home to thousands of migratory birds, including the iconic pink flamingos. The area's unique charm lies in its serene landscapes, offering residents and visitors a peaceful retreat from the dynamic energy of Dubai while still being well-connected to major landmarks and attractions. Beyond its natural wonders, Ras Al Khor is an emerging residential and commercial hub, offering a blend of modern infrastructure and tranquil surroundings. The district features a mix of upscale developments, spacious villas, and waterfront residences, all designed to provide a harmonious balance between luxury and sustainability. With easy access to Dubai Creek, Downtown Dubai, and major road networks, Ras Al Khor ensures a seamless lifestyle that combines convenience with scenic beauty. As Dubai continues to grow, Ras Al Khor remains a testament to the city's commitment to preserving its natural heritage while embracing modern progress. Future developments in the area promise to enhance its appeal with new residential communities, leisure destinations, and cultural attractions. Whether you are drawn to its stunning wildlife sanctuary, its picturesque waterfront views, or its growing urban landscape, Ras Al Khor offers a unique living experience where nature and city life coexist in perfect harmony.

Portside Square is developed by Ellington in Mina Rashid, a historic port district that opened in 1972 and now includes a marina and cruise terminal. Its 408 homes range from studios of 396 sq ft to four-bedroom penthouses of 3,441 sq ft, with one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments and two-bedroom units with a study in between.

The Queen Elizabeth 2 is about a minute's drive away, Sheikh Zayed Road six minutes, and Downtown Dubai, Dubai World Trade Centre and Dubai International Airport around 10 minutes.

The location links Mina Rashid's maritime heritage with short drives to the city's business districts, including DIFC at about 14 minutes. Homes are offered on a freehold basis, and the project is registered with the Dubai Land Department.
